tasks.notes: the Proof's exam failed: bun test tests/state-exams/clear-completed.test.ts — exit 1

plan-defect: leg (p) — the `checked: true` / `unchecked: true` view entries cannot pass on the render-ran branch, for a reason no implementation can reach. The helper's `REFLECT_CHECKED` in `packages/tinyapp-exam/src/render-move.ts:170` writes `data-checked` unconditionally from inside its own `MutationObserver(..., {attributes: true})`, so every write re-triggers the callback. On the app's ~1.9 MB bundled page that loop starves the renderer and `/snapshot` answers 422 `code 6002` ("A timeout was reached") after ~61 s, so `renderMove` throws `render failed: 422 …` and the exam is red before any view entry is read. Measured 3/3 identical against the live TINYAPP_RENDER_URL. Isolated: the same page with NO script tag renders 200 in ~2 s with `#doneCount` = "1 of 2 done", 2 `.todoItem`, 1 `.todoItem.completed`; the same page with a one-shot (no-observer) reflect renders 200 in ~2 s but `data-checked` is absent on both inputs, because the app paints after `addScriptTag` runs — which is why the observer is there. Adding a single guard (`var v=i.checked?'true':'false'; if(i.getAttribute('data-checked')!==v){i.setAttribute('data-checked',v)}`) makes the whole thing pass: 200 in 3.7 s with `input#todo-0` = `data-checked="false"` and `input#todo-1` = `data-checked="true"`, plus all three other view entries. I did not apply that fix — `packages/tinyapp-exam/` is outside my FILES and is the measurement apparatus, not the implementation. Incidental answer to the run's live question this pins down: Cloudflare's `/snapshot` DOES honour `addScriptTag` (the injected script is present in the returned DOM and its effects are serialised).; plan-defect: leg (p), second and independent — `stateExam` registers its bun test with no timeout (`packages/tinyapp-exam/src/state-exam.ts:151`), and bun's default is 5000 ms. A healthy render move on this page costs 2–6 s (bundle + POST), so even with the observer fixed the exam fails as `this test timed out after 5000ms` whenever `TINYAPP_RENDER_URL` and `ULTRA_RUN_DIR` are both set. Measured: my scratch copy of the task's exact `stateExam` call died at exactly 5000.81 ms; the identical call under `--timeout 120000` got as far as the renderer. The suite as configured has no `--timeout` flag, so the peer's exam needs one (or `test(..., {timeout})` inside the helper) to reach the render branch at all. On the render-skipped branch — no `ULTRA_RUN_DIR`, which is how my environment is set — neither of these bites and the exam should be green.

task 1: exam: `state exam: clear-completed` stays red whenever the driver sets both TINYAPP_RENDER_URL and ULTRA_RUN_DIR, and no change inside this task's Files can make it green. Cause 1: packages/tinyapp-exam/src/state-exam.ts:151 registers the test with bun's default 5000ms timeout while the render move needs 1.9-3.4s at best (30-61s when the renderer stalls) — the driver's `timed out after 5000ms` is that wall. Cause 2: the renderer strips single quotes from addScriptTag content, so the helper's single-quoted REFLECT_CHECKED never runs and the `unchecked` view can never hold. Control: the fixture's own tests/state-exams/buy-milk.test.ts, run at BASE a2135f1 with no task code present, fails the same way (render failed: 422 code 6002, 61s). A fix belongs in the helper (pass a timeout to `test`, double-quote REFLECT_CHECKED), which no task's Files block owns; I left the helper, the exam and client/index.html untouched.
